votes.motion: Moved by Council Member Fowler, seconded by Council Member Wharton to enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137.
votes.description: The Council voted to enter a closed session to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and privileged attorney-client matters.

votes.motion: Moved by Council Member Fowler, seconded by Council Member Wharton to exit the Closed Session.
votes.description: The Council voted to conclude and exit the closed session.
